visualCharacteristics.purpose: Live share price widget beside an explanatory text
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text column (4 of 12) beside the centred big price with trend arrow and exchange caption; stacked on mobile
notable: Fetches the live XETRA quote on scroll-in

contentPattern.structure: One row: text cell (heading, copy) and price cell (price as displayed, caption); optional config row source | url

usage: Use on investor pages to show today's share price next to context text.
reuseGuidance: Fits one live quote; key-figures (stock) covers a price among other figures.
